flow_ref: User story (not in the flow deck of OCMS)
code_summary: ocmsadminapi workflows/payment_reduction/reduction/helpers/ReductionPersistenceService (writes VON, suspended_notice, reduced_offence_amount without any endorsement status), crud/ocmsizdb/OcmsReduction/OcmsReducedOffenceAmount. ocmsadminui pages/Dashboard/Dashboard.tsx (empty page), utils/constant.ts (endorsement only for UPL), pages/NoticeUPL (UPL notice endorsement, not reduction). ocmsadminprivateapi, ocmseserviceapi, ocmseserviceui, thirdpartyapi: no code
note: Story status: Requirement given - Gen flow (3 points). There is no routing of reductions to a supervisor: after a successful reduction the persistence only writes VON, suspended_notice, reduced_offence_amount and the internet VON, with no pending-endorsement status; the staff portal dashboard is an empty page; endorsement in the staff portal exists only for UPL notices and is not connected to reductions; grep 'endors' in src/main of ocmsadminapi and ocmsadminprivateapi finds nothing. Whether PLUS has supervisor endorsement for reductions: cannot verify from repo. No relevant maintenance ticket.
recommendation: No code exists for this story; do not claim. The existing endorsement is only for UPL notices. Ask URA/the team to confirm whether reduction endorsement is built in PLUS.

steps.step: After a successful reduction, OCMS auto-routes the list of notices for endorsement
steps.detail: The reduction persistence only writes VON (TS-RED), suspended_notice, ocms_reduced_offence_amount and the internet VON (ocmsadminapi/src/main/java/com/ocmsintranet/apiservice/workflows/payment_reduction/reduction/helpers/ReductionPersistenceService.java:56-74). There is no pending-endorsement status or flag and no endorsement column in the OcmsReducedOffenceAmount entity (columns: notice_no, sr_no, date, amount, reason, expiry, officer, remarks). No job or event builds a list for a supervisor.

steps.step: The list of notices appears on the supervisor's dashboard in OCMS
steps.detail: The staff portal Dashboard page only contains an empty div with no widget or list (ocmsadminui/src/pages/Dashboard/Dashboard.tsx:21-27, a 34-line file). There is no supervisor-specific dashboard and no query for a reduction list.

steps.step: The supervisor endorses the reductions given to the notices
steps.detail: Endorsement in the staff portal is only for UPL notices (constant.ts:301-302 'UPL Endorsement' / 'UPL Notice Pending Endorsement'; NoticeEndorseList.tsx:49 for a UPL notice_no) and is not connected to TS-RED/reduction. There is no endpoint to endorse a reduction in ocmsadminapi or ocmsadminprivateapi (grep 'endors' in src/main: no result). The UPL mechanism is not counted as code for this story.
